同一固定源码中搜索“冷却”；不足时按 Skill 检查主题和搜索词，以 Cooldown 做有界检索并继续一页。遇到错误时保留原 pin，恢复后继续。

sourceTaskScope: The three original full-Retail Source tasks are unchanged; their results are selected Source use, not Data or Live acceptance.

original CON/request/deadline and real keyboard/INPUT observations

actual resource-pressure failure and effective-limit evidence
